name: Jordan Lee
headline: Python Automation Engineer
summary: Python backend engineer with experience building automation scripts, FastAPI services, scheduled ETL jobs, internal workflow tools, observability dashboards, and technical documentation for product and operations stakeholders.

experience.title: Backend Engineer
bullets: Built Python automation scripts that reduced weekly reporting time from 5 hours to 20 minutes for internal teams.
Designed internal workflow tools and REST APIs using FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
Migrated manual spreadsheet processes into scheduled ETL jobs with validation, alerting, and clearer handoffs.
Created GitHub Actions CI checks and deployment scripts for a small engineering team.
Partnered with product managers to define technical requirements, milestones, and delivery scope.
Improved observability with structured logging, metrics dashboards, and on-call runbooks.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Maintained Python services that processed customer account updates and billing events.
Wrote SQL queries and data quality checks for operations dashboards.
Documented API behavior, deployment steps, and common support workflows.

projects.name: Workflow Rules Engine
projects.description: Python rules engine for routing operational tasks based on account attributes and service requirements.
bullets: Built routing logic based on account status, SLA, and customer tier to support internal workflow automation.
Added validation reports that helped non-engineering teams identify incomplete records before handoff.

Kept collaboration with product managers and operations-facing work because the source resume supports both through requirements work, operations dashboards, and non-engineering handoffs.
Avoided adding unsupported tools, certifications, cloud platforms, or business-domain claims.
